title: Gideon's Calling
description: The angel of the Lord appears to Gideon while he is threshing wheat in secret from the Midianites at Ophrah. Gideon tears down his father's altar to Baal, gathers an army from Manasseh, Asher, Zebulun, and Naphtali, and asks God to confirm his calling with a fleece of wool.
